INTELLECTUAL FOUNDATIONS, CRITICAL EXAMINATION & ORIGINAL SYNTHESIS

A broad foundation. A distinct original discipline.

The work was built through systematic study across procurement, supply management, decision science, governance, finance, law, risk, audit, continuity, operations, technology, artificial intelligence and international standards — followed by critical examination and original cross-domain synthesis.

STANDARDS & MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS

Compliance is a foundation. Decision integrity requires more.

ISO, NIST, COSO, European and international public-procurement frameworks are acknowledged as studied foundations. Their appearance does not imply endorsement, certification, sponsorship or validation of Sovereign Decision Science™.

THE FOUNDATIONAL TECHNICAL CORPUS

Four works. One continuous scientific architecture.

The foundational works are not isolated publications. Together they move from procurement governance to supply sovereignty, contractual continuity and the verifiable operating architecture of decision integrity.

THE DECISION BLIND SPOT SERIES™

Where conventional management tools stop.

Six concise executive briefings expose the blind spots between recorded process and defensible decision. The Starter Bundle contains the first three briefings plus the guided executive reading route.
